choices.text: the northern Pacific with winds up to 64 knots.
the Indian Ocean with winds 65 knots or more.
the north Atlantic with winds 35 to 64 knots.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Indian Ocean에서 최대 지속풍속 약 64~65 kt 이상의 강한 tropical cyclone은 cyclone이라 부른다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: A hurricane has formed when

choices.text: the highest sustained winds are 64 knots or more.
the winds around a pressure storm have averaged 48 knots for over 48 hours.
the barometric pressure in the center of the storm is 35 mb lower than pressure outside the weather feature.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Hurricane 또는 typhoon의 최대 지속풍속 기준은 64 kt 이상이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Tropical storms form when

choices.text: a system of air surrounds an area with pressure of 48 mb.
a system has sustained winds of 34 to 63 knots.
a system has peak wind gusts that do not exceed 65 knots.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Tropical storm의 최대 지속풍속 기준은 34~63 kt이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: A tropical cyclone is

choices.text: a tropical storm in the north Atlantic west of Newfoundland with highest sustained winds of 25 through 33 knots.
a tropical depression in the Northern Pacific near Dutch Harbor with sustained winds of 63 knots.
a hurricane force storm in the Pacific Ocean southwest of Hawaii with highest sustained winds of 65 knots or higher.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 최대 지속풍속 64 kt 이상의 회전성 열대 저기압은 hurricane/cyclone/typhoon 등으로 분류되는 강한 tropical cyclone이다. 국제 분류는 depression ≤33 kt, storm 34~63 kt, hurricane/cyclone/typhoon ≥64 kt이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Gusts in tropical cyclones can exceed the average one-minute wind speed by as much as
questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Tropical cyclone은 1분 평균 풍속으로 강도를 분류하며, 순간 gust는 이 평균풍속보다 최대 약 50% 더 강할 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Which weather condition is present when a tropical storm is upgraded to a typhoon?

choices.text: Winds around the pressure center have averaged 48 knots or more for 48 continuous hours.
The storm has sustained winds of 64 knots or more.
Barometric pressure at the center is 35 mb lower than the surrounding pressure.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Hurricane 또는 typhoon으로 분류되려면 최대 지속풍속이 64 kt 이상이어야 한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Which type of weather can only be directly observed during flight and then reported in a PIREP?

choices.text: Level of the tropopause and turbulence.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. 조종사는 직접 관측한 뇌우, structural icing, turbulence, wind shear, cloud base/top/layer, visibility, precipitation, 바람, 고도별 온도 등을 자발적으로 PIREP으로 보고하는 것이 권장된다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What type turbulence should be reported when it momentarily causes slight, erratic changes in altitude and/or attitude, one-third to two-thirds of the time?
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Light turbulence는 고도나 자세에 순간적이고 경미한 불규칙 변화가 생기는 정도이다. Intermittent는 전체 시간의 약 1/3~2/3 동안 발생함을 뜻한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What type turbulence should be reported when it causes slight, rapid, and somewhat rhythmic bumpiness without appreciable changes in attitude or altitude, less than one-third of the time?
questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Light chop은 고도·자세의 뚜렷한 변화 없이 작고 빠르며 비교적 규칙적인 흔들림이다. Occasional은 전체 시간의 1/3 미만 동안 발생한다는 뜻이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What type turbulence should be reported when it causes changes in altitude and/or attitude more than two-thirds of the time, with the aircraft remaining in positive control at all times?
questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Moderate turbulence는 고도나 자세 변화가 발생하지만 항공기는 항상 positive control 상태를 유지하는 정도이다. Continuous는 전체 시간의 2/3보다 많이 발생함을 뜻한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: KFTW UA/OV DFW/TM 1645/FL100/TP PA30/ SK SCT031- TOP043/BKN060-TOP085/OVC097- TOPUNKN/WX FV00SM RA/TA 07. This pilot report to Fort Worth (KFTW) indicates

choices.text: the ceiling at KDFW is 6,000 feet.
that the top of the ceiling is 4,300 feet.
the aircraft is in light rain.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Ceiling은 가장 낮은 BKN/OVC 층 또는 obscuration 속 vertical visibility의 높이이다. PIREP의 BKN060은 6,000 ft MSL을 뜻하며, PIREP 고도는 별도 표시가 없으면 MSL이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Maximum Turbulence Potential forecasts

choices.text: are only as accurate as the computer model.
exhibit the same accuracy during all 24 hours of the day.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. 이 turbulence forecast 제품은 여러 turbulence indicator를 ensemble로 결합하므로 단일 지표보다 다양한 난류 원인을 반영할 수 있다. 정확도는 입력되는 computer model 자료의 정확도에 좌우된다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What determines how icing is reported on a PIREP?
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Icing intensity는 얼음이 축적되는 속도에 따라 분류한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What is indicated by the following report? TYR UUA/OV TYR180015/TM 1757/FL310/TP B737/TB MOD-SEV CAT 350-390

choices.text: An urgent pilot report for moderate to severe clear air turbulence.
A routine pilot report for overcast conditions from flight levels 350-390.
A special METAR issued on the 18th day of the month at 1757Z.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. PIREP의 UUA는 Urgent Upper Air report를 뜻하고, '/TB MOD-SEV CAT 350-390'은 FL350~390에서 moderate to severe clear-air turbulence가 있음을 의미한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: The Hazardous Inflight Weather Advisory Service (HIWAS) is a continuous broadcast over selected VORs of

choices.text: SIGMETs, CONVECTIVE SIGMETs, AIRMETs, Severe Weather Forecast Alerts (AWW), and Center Weather Advisories (CWA).
SIGMETs, CONVECTIVE SIGMETs, AIRMETs, Wind Shear Advisories, and Severe Weather Forecast Alerts (AWW).
Wind Shear Advisories, Radar Weather Reports, SIGMETs, CONVECTIVE SIGMETs, AIRMETs, and Center Weather Advisories (CWA).

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. HIWAS는 선택된 VOR를 통해 SIGMET, Convective SIGMET, AIRMET, severe weather forecast alert, CWA 등 비행 중 기상 advisory를 지속 방송하는 서비스이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: En route weather advisories should be obtained from an FSS on
questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. FSS는 항로비행 항공기와의 공통 통신 주파수로 122.2 MHz를 제공한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: At what time are current AIRMETs broadcast in their entirety by the Hazardous Inflight Weather Advisory Service (HIWAS)?

choices.text: 15 and 45 minutes after the hour during the first hour after issuance, and upon receipt.
Every 15 minutes until the AIRMET is canceled.
There is a continuous broadcast over selected VORs of Inflight Weather Advisories.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. HIWAS는 선택된 VOR를 통해 AIRMET, SIGMET, Convective SIGMET, CWA, urgent PIREP, severe weather forecast alert 요약 등을 지속 방송한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What wind direction and speed aloft are forecast by this WINDS AND TEMPERATURE ALOFT FORECAST (FB) for FL 390 - “750649”?
questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Winds Aloft code에서 방향 그룹이 51~86이면 풍속이 100 kt 이상이다. 방향에서 50을 빼고 풍속에 100을 더한다. 따라서 7506은 250°/106 kt이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What wind direction and speed aloft are forecast by this WINDS AND TEMPERATURE ALOFT FORECAST (FB) report for FL 390 - “731960”?
questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. 방향 그룹이 36보다 크면 100 kt 이상 풍속으로 해석한다. 73에서 50을 빼면 230°, 속도 19에 100을 더하면 119 kt이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: A station is forecasting wind and temperature aloft to be 280° at 205 knots; temperature –51°C at FL 390. How would this data be encoded in the FB?
questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. FL390의 280°/205 kt는 789951처럼 encode한다. 200 kt 이상이면 속도 그룹은 99로 쓰고 방향 코드에 50을 더하며, 24,000 ft 이상에서는 음의 온도 부호를 생략한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: SPECI KGLS 131802Z 10012G21KT 060V140 2SM +SHRA SCT005 BKN035 OVC050CB 24/23 A2980 RMK RAB57 WS TKO RW09L WSHFT 58 FROPA. This SPECI report at Galveston (KGLS) indicates which condition?

choices.text: Wind steady at 100° magnetic at 12 knots, gusts to 21.
Precipitation started at 57 after the hour.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. KGLS SPECI RMK의 RAB57은 57분에 비 시작, WS TKO RW09L은 RWY 09L 이륙 중 wind shear, WSHFT 58 FROPA는 frontal passage로 58분에 wind shift가 발생했다는 뜻이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: METAR KMAF 131756Z 02020KT 12SM BKN025 OVC250 27/18 A3009 RMK RAE44. Which weather condition is indicated by this METAR report at Midland (KMAF)?

choices.text: Rain of unknown intensity ended 16 minutes before the hour.
The ceiling was at 25,000 feet MSL.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. KMAF RMK의 RAE44는 해당 시각 44분에 비가 끝났다는 의미이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: METAR KSPS 131757Z 09014KT 6SM -RA SCT025 OVC090 24/22 A3005. SPECI KSPS 131820Z 01025KT 3SM +RA FC OVC015 22/21 A3000. What change took place at Wichita Falls (KSPS) between 1757 and 1820 UTC?
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. KSPS 1820Z SPECI의 FC는 funnel cloud가 관측되었다는 뜻이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: METAR KHRO 131753Z 09007KT 7SM FEW020 BKN040CB 30/27 A3001. SPECI KHRO 131815Z 13017G26KT 3SM +TSRA SCT020 BKN045TCU 29/24 A2983 RMK RAB12 WS TKO LDG RW14R FRQ LTGICCG VC. What change has taken place between 1753 and 1815 UTC at Harrison (KHRO)?

choices.text: The ceiling lowered and cumulonimbus clouds developed.
Thundershowers began at 12 minutes past the hour.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. KHRO 1815Z SPECI의 +TSRA는 thunderstorm with heavy rain이고, RMK RAB12는 비가 12분에 시작되었음을 뜻한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: The prevailing visibility in the following METAR is METAR KFSM 131756Z AUTO 00000KT M1/4SM R25/0600V1000FT -RA FG VV004 06/05 A2989 RMK A02 $.
questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. 자동관측소에서 prevailing visibility가 1/4 SM 미만이면 M1/4SM으로 보고한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: The VV001 in the following METAR indicates METAR KFSM 131756Z AUTO 00000KT M1/4SM R25/0600V1000FT -RA FG VV001 A2989 RMK AO2 VIS 3/4 RWY19 CHINO RWY19 $.

choices.text: an observer reported the vertical visibility as 100 feet.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. METAR의 VV001은 obscuration 속 vertical visibility 100 ft, 즉 indefinite ceiling 100 ft를 의미한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: The symbol ($) at the end of the following METAR indicates that METAR KFSM 131756Z AUTO 00000KT M1/4SM R25/0600V1000FT -RA FG VV004 06/05 A2989 RMK A02 $.

choices.text: the latest information is transmitted over a discrete VHF frequency at KFSM.
the latest information is broadcast on the voice portion of a local NAVAID at KFSM.
maintenance is needed on the system.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 자동기상관측시스템이 정비 필요를 감지하면 METAR에 '$' maintenance indicator가 붙는다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: A squall is a sudden increase of at least 16 knots in average wind speed to a sustained speed of

choices.text: 26 knots or more for at least 1 minute.
20 knots or more for at least 1 minute.
22 knots or more for at least 1 minute.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Squall은 평균풍속이 갑자기 최소 16 kt 증가해 22 kt 이상이 되고 그 상태가 최소 1분 지속되는 현상이며 METAR에서는 SQ로 보고한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: If squalls are reported at the destination airport, what wind conditions exist?

choices.text: Sudden increases in wind speed of at least 15 knots to a sustained wind speed of 20 knots, lasting for at least 1 minute.
Rapid variation in wind direction of at least 20° and changes in speed of at least 10 knots between peaks and lulls.
A sudden increase in wind speed of at least 16 knots, the speed rising to 22 knots or more for 1 minute or longer.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Squall의 기준은 풍속이 갑자기 최소 16 kt 증가하고 최종 풍속이 22 kt 이상이며 1분 이상 지속되는 것이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Data that may be added (manual weather augmentation) to the Automated Weather Observing System (AWOS) report is limited to

choices.text: the precipitation accumulation report, an automated variable visibility, and wind direction remark.
thunderstorms (intensity and direction), precipitation (type and intensity), and obstructions to visibility (dependent on the visibility being 3 miles or less).
density altitude, NOTAMs, and reported slant range visibility.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. AWOS METAR에 사람이 추가한 manual augmentation remark는 RMK에 들어간다. 일반적으로 thunderstorm의 강도·방향, 강수 종류·강도, 시정 3 SM 이하일 때의 obstruction to vision 등을 추가한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: METAR KFSO 031053Z VRB02KT 7SM MIFG SKC 15/14 A3012 RMK SLP993 60000 T01500139 56012 In the above METAR, the SLP993 60000 indicates

choices.text: sea-level pressure 999.3 hectopascals which in the last 6 hours has dropped .4 hectopascals.
sea-level pressure 999.3 hectopascals and a trace amount of precipitation has occurred over the last 3 hours.
sea-level pressure 999.3 hectopascals and in the last 6 hours that four-tenths of an inch of precipitation has fallen.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. RMK SLP993은 sea-level pressure 999.3 hPa이다. 6xxxx group은 3/6시간 강수량을 inch의 십·일·0.1·0.01 단위로 표시하며 60000은 trace 강수를 의미한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: METAR KFSO 031053Z VRB02KT 7SM MIFG SKC 15/14 A3012 RMK SLP993 SNINCR 1/10 In the above METAR, the SNINCR 1/10 indicates

choices.text: sea-level pressure 999.3 hectopascals and a snow depth of 10" and a 1" increase in the last hour.
sea-level pressure 999.3 hectopascals and 0.10" of snow on the runway landing zone during the last hour.
sea-level pressure 999.3 hectopascals and 1" of snow in the last 10 hours.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. SNINCR 표시는 지난 1시간 동안 적설이 1 inch 증가했고 현재 총 snow depth가 10 inches라는 뜻이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Which primary source contains information regarding the expected weather at the destination airport at the ETA?
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. TAF는 특정 기간, 보통 24시간 동안 공항에서 예상되는 기상상태를 간결하게 예보하며 ETA의 목적공항 예상기상을 판단하는 데 사용한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Weather conditions expected to occur in the vicinity of the airport, but not at the airport, are denoted by the letters “VC.” When VC appears in a Terminal Aerodrome Forecast, it covers a geographical area of

choices.text: a 5-to-10 statute mile radius from the airport.
a 5-mile radius of the center of a runway complex.
10 miles of the station originating the forecast.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. TAF의 VC(vicinity)는 공항 자체가 아니라 공항에서 약 5~10 SM 범위 안에서 예상되는 현상을 뜻한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What weather is predicted by the term VCTS in a Terminal Aerodrome Forecast?

choices.text: Thunderstorms are expected in the vicinity.
Thunderstorms may occur over the station and within 50 miles of the station.
Thunderstorms are expected between 5 and 25 miles of the runway complex.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. TAF의 VCTS는 thunderstorm이 공항 자체가 아니라 vicinity, 즉 약 5~10 SM 범위에서 예상된다는 뜻이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Which are the only cloud types forecast in the Terminal Aerodrome Forecast?
questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. TAF에서 cumulonimbus가 예상되면 해당 cloud layer 뒤에 CB를 붙인다. TAF에서 별도로 예보하는 cloud type은 CB뿐이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: A calm wind that is forecast, in the International Terminal Aerodrome Forecast (TAF), is encoded as
questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. TAF의 calm wind는 00000KT로 encode한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: In the International Terminal Aerodrome Forecast (TAF), a variable wind direction is noted by “VRB” where the three digit direction usually appears. A calm wind appears in the TAF as
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. TAF에서 calm wind는 00000KT로 표시한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: A PROB40 (PROBability) HHhh group in an International Terminal Aerodrome Forecast (TAF) indicates the probability of
questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. TAF의 PROB40 HHhh는 지정 시간대에 thunderstorm 또는 강수현상이 발생할 확률이 40%, 즉 30% 이상 50% 미만임을 뜻한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What is the single source reference that contains information regarding volcanic eruption, turbulence, and icing conditions for a specific region?
questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. In-flight aviation weather advisory는 특정 지역의 volcanic eruption, turbulence, icing 등의 정보를 제공한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What information is provided by a Convective Outlook (AC)?

choices.text: It describes areas of probable severe icing and severe or extreme turbulence during the next 24 hours.
It provides prospects of both general and severe thunderstorm activity and specific severe weather threats during the following 8 days.
It indicates areas of probable convective turbulence and the extent of instability in the upper atmosphere (above 500 mb).

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Convective Outlook은 향후 8일간의 일반 및 severe thunderstorm 가능성을 전망하며 high, moderate, enhanced, slight, marginal risk 구역 등을 표시한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Maximum turbulence potential charts (GTG-3) are issued
questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. GTG-3 maximum turbulence potential chart는 upper-level front와 jet stream 관련 CAT 가능성을 4차원으로 예측하는 computer-generated product이다. 매시간 갱신되며 6/9/12시간 forecast도 주기적으로 업데이트된다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Isobars on a surface weather chart represent lines of equal pressure

choices.text: at a given atmospheric pressure altitude.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Surface analysis chart의 isobar는 sea-level pressure가 같은 지점을 연결하며 보통 4 mb(hPa) 간격이다. 이를 통해 표고가 다른 관측소의 기압을 비교할 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: A prognostic chart depicts the conditions

choices.text: existing at the surface during the past 6 hours.
which presently exist from the 1,000-millibar through the 700-millibar level.
forecast to exist at a specific time in the future.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Prognostic chart는 차트의 valid time(UTC/Z)에 예상되는 기상상태를 나타내며 하루 네 차례 발행된다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: For international flights, a U.S. High-Level Significant Weather Prognostic Chart is prepared for use

choices.text: between 25,000 feet and 63,000 feet pressure altitude.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. High-Level SIGWX Prognostic Chart는 국제비행을 위해 AWC가 작성하며 대략 FL250~FL630(25,000~63,000 ft pressure altitude) 구간을 다룬다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Forecast winds and temperatures aloft for an international flight may be obtained by consulting

choices.text: low-level significant weather prog charts published by the departure location host country.
the current Ceiling and Visibility Analysis appropriate to the route.
Wind and Temperature Aloft Charts prepared by the U.S. National Centers for Environmental Prediction (NCEP).

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 국제비행의 forecast winds and temperatures aloft는 NCEP가 작성하는 Winds and Temperatures Aloft Chart에서 얻을 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What sources reflect the most accurate information on current and forecast icing conditions?

choices.text: Low-Level Sig Weather Prog Chart, RADAT’s, and the Area Forecast.
PIREP’s, Area Forecast, and the Freezing Level Chart.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 특정 지역의 현재 icing 상태는 PIREP이 가장 직접적이며 type과 intensity를 포함할 수 있다. AIRMET Zulu는 icing/freezing level, SIGMET은 severe icing에 발행된다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: A public severe thunderstorm watch implies

choices.text: 58 mph winds or greater and/or surface hail of 1 inch or more in diameter.
45 mph winds or greater and/or surface hail of 1 inch or more in diameter.
50 knots or greater and/or surface hail of 1/2 inch or greater.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. NWS severe thunderstorm watch는 58 mph(50 kt) 이상 지상풍 및/또는 직경 1 inch 이상 지상 hail 가능 조건에서 발행될 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Constant Pressure Analysis Charts contain contours, isotherms, and some contain isotachs. The contours depict

choices.text: ridges, lows, troughs, and highs aloft.
highs, lows, troughs, and ridges on the surface.
highs, lows, troughs, and ridges corrected to MSL.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Constant pressure analysis chart에는 contour와 isotherm, 일부에는 isotach가 있다. Contour는 같은 geopotential height를 연결하며 상층의 high/low/trough/ridge를 지상 isobar처럼 나타낸다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Vertical wind shear can be determined by comparing winds on vertically adjacent constant pressure charts. The vertical wind shear that is critical for probability of turbulence is
questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Probable turbulence에 중요한 vertical wind shear 기준은 1,000 ft당 약 5 kt 이상이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: The horizontal wind shear, critical for turbulence (moderate or greater) per 150 miles is

choices.text: not a factor, only vertical shear is a factor.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Moderate 이상 turbulence와 관련된 중요한 horizontal wind shear는 150 NM당 18 kt 초과이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: If a SIGMET alert is announced, how can information contained in the SIGMET be obtained?

choices.text: ATC will announce the hazard and advise when information will be provided in the FSS broadcast.
By contacting a weather watch station.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 기상 advisory alert를 들었지만 내용을 받지 못했거나 자기 비행에 해당하는지 불확실하면 가장 가까운 FSS에 연락해 관련 여부를 확인해야 한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Which type weather conditions are covered in the Convective SIGMET?

choices.text: Embedded thunderstorms, lines of thunderstorms, and thunderstorms with 3/4-inch hail or tornadoes.
Cumulonimbus clouds with tops above the tropopause and thunderstorms with 1/2-inch hail or funnel clouds.
Any thunderstorm with a severity level of VIP 2 or more.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Convective SIGMET은 severe thunderstorm(풍속 >50 kt, hail ≥3/4 inch, tornado), embedded thunderstorm, line of thunderstorms, 또는 일정 면적의 강한 thunderstorm 활동 등에 발행된다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: A severe thunderstorm is one in which the surface wind is

choices.text: 58 mph or greater and/or surface hail is 3/4 inch or more in diameter.
50 knots or greater and/or surface hail is 1/2 inch or more in diameter.
45 knots or greater and/or surface hail is 1 inch or more in diameter.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Severe thunderstorm 기준은 지상풍 ≥58 mph(50 kt), 지상 hail 직경 ≥3/4 inch, 또는 tornado 발생이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: When you hear a SIGMET on an ATC frequency forecasting severe icing conditions on the route to your destination, you plan for

choices.text: the installed transport category airplane ice protection system protecting against all types and levels of icing as designed.
very little airframe icing because of an OAT of -10°C or colder, the moisture is already frozen and cannot adhere to airplane surfaces.
the possibility of freezing rain and freezing drizzle that can accumulate on and beyond the limits of any system.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Severe icing은 얼음 축적률이 너무 커 deicing/anti-icing 장비로도 위험을 줄이거나 통제하지 못하는 상태이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: SIGMETs may be issued for the contiguous U.S.

choices.text: and as convective SIGMETs for Alaska and Hawaii when squall lines are forecast.
and as convective SIGMETs for Alaska when obscured thunderstorms are forecast.
as convective SIGMETs when obscured thunderstorms are forecast.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. CONUS에서는 thunderstorm에 일반 SIGMET 대신 Convective SIGMET을 사용한다. Convective SIGMET은 severe 이상 turbulence, severe icing, low-level wind shear 가능성을 내포한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Convective SIGMETs are issued for a line of thunderstorms at least

choices.text: 100 miles long with severe thunderstorms affecting 50 percent of its length.
40 miles long with thunderstorms affecting 50 percent of its length.
60 miles long with thunderstorms affecting 40 percent of its length.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Convective SIGMET은 thunderstorm line이 최소 60 mi 길이이고 40% 이상에서 뇌우가 있거나, 최소 3,000 sq mi 영역의 40% 이상이 매우 강한 radar/satellite/lightning signature를 보이는 active thunderstorm일 때 발행될 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Convective SIGMETs are issued for severe thunderstorms

choices.text: occurring for more than one hour of the valid period.
occurring for more than 30 minutes of the valid period.
affecting more than 1,000 square miles of airspace.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Embedded 또는 severe thunderstorm이 valid period 중 30분 넘게 지속될 것으로 예상되면 영역 크기와 관계없이 Convective SIGMET을 발행한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: A SIGMET is issued when weather affects
questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. SIGMET은 예보관 판단상 항공운항 안전에 중대한 영향을 주는 현상이 최소 약 3,000 sq mi 지역에 영향을 주거나 줄 것으로 예상될 때 발행될 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: SIGMETs (other than domestic convective SIGMETs) may be valid for not more than

choices.text: 4 hours for other phenomena and may be issued 2 hours before the valid time.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. SIGMET 유효기간은 hurricane 관련 현상은 6시간, 기타 현상은 4시간이며 현상이 계속되면 업데이트해 재발행한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: A SIGMET may be issued

choices.text: for an area where conditions are deemed to have a significant effect on the safety of aircraft operations.
when expectations for dust storms or icing is predicted to be higher than 40% over a 1,000 square mile area.
for an area where conditions are likely to develop air turbulence above FL 310.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. SIGMET은 지정된 위험현상이 발생했거나 발생할 것으로 예상되어 항공운항 안전에 중대한 영향을 준다고 판단될 때 발행한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: The Mid-Level Significant weather (SIGWX) Chart is used to determine an overview of flying weather conditions between what altitudes?
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Mid-Level SIGWX Chart는 10,000 ft MSL~FL450 범위의 주요 비행기상을 한눈에 보여주며 출발 전·비행 중 flight planning과 weather briefing에 사용할 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: The Federal Aviation Administration’s Flight Information Service Data Link (FISDL) is designed to provide data on a common frequency to flight crews from

choices.text: 17,500 feet AGL down to 5,000 feet MSL.
17,500 feet MSL down to 5,000 feet AGL.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. FISDL은 산악지형 때문에 불가능한 곳을 제외하고 continental U.S.에서 약 5,000 ft AGL~17,500 ft MSL 범위 커버리지를 목표로 설계되었다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: The Federal Aviation Administration’s Flight Information Service Data Link (FISDL) provides what products?

choices.text: Convective SIGMETs, PIREPs, AWWs, and NOTAMs.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. FISDL은 METAR, SPECI, TAF/수정본, SIGMET, Convective SIGMET, AIRMET, urgent/routine PIREP, AWW 등을 무료로 제공한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: The Federal Aviation Administration’s Flight Information Service Data Link (FISDL) products, such as ground radar precipitation maps,

choices.text: may be used instead of the aircraft radar.
are not appropriate for finding a path through a weather hazard area.
may be used to find a path through a weather hazard area.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. FISDL의 radar precipitation map 같은 제품은 severe weather 사이를 전술적으로 통과하는 tactical avoidance 용도가 아니다. 위험구역 전체를 피하도록 항로를 선택하는 strategic decision에 사용해야 한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What weather database can a dispatcher access concerning wind shear activity at an airport?
questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Dispatcher는 TWIP database를 이용해 공항에서 wind shear 활동이 시작되거나 끝날 때 특정 항공기에 메시지를 보낼 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What is an important characteristic of wind shear?

choices.text: It is primarily associated with the lateral vortices generated by thunderstorms.
It usually exists only in the vicinity of thunderstorms, but may be found near a strong temperature inversion.
It may be associated with either a wind shift or a windspeed gradient at any level in the atmosphere.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Wind shear는 바람속도 벡터가 변하는 비율이며 풍속, 풍향 또는 둘 다의 변화일 수 있다. 대기의 어느 고도에서도 wind shift나 wind-speed gradient 형태로 발생할 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Which is a definition of “severe wind shear”?

choices.text: Any rapid change of horizontal wind shear in excess of 25 knots; vertical shear excepted.
Any rapid change in wind direction or velocity which causes airspeed changes greater than 15 knots or vertical speed changes greater than 500 ft/min.
Any change of airspeed greater than 20 knots which is sustained for more than 20 seconds or vertical speed changes in excess of 100 ft/min.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Severe wind shear는 급격한 풍향·풍속 변화로 airspeed가 15 kt 초과 변하거나 vertical speed가 500 ft/min 초과 변하는 경우를 말한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What information from the control tower is indicated by the following transmission? “SOUTH BOUNDARY WIND ONE SIX ZERO AT TWO FIVE, WEST BOUNDARY WIND TWO FOUR ZERO AT THREE FIVE.”

choices.text: A downburst is located at the center of the airport.
Wake turbulence exists on the west side of the active runway.
There is a possibility of wind shear over or near the airport.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. LLWAS는 공항 주변 여러 지점의 바람을 중심부 바람과 비교해 low-level wind shear 가능성을 탐지한다. 차이가 커지면 tower가 해당 위치와 바람을 조종사에게 제공한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What airport condition is reported by the tower when more than one wind condition at different positions on the airport is reported?
questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Tower가 공항 내 서로 다른 위치에서 두 개 이상의 wind condition을 보고하면 wind shear 가능성이 높다는 뜻이다. 이는 LLWAS 여러 sensor의 풍향·풍속 차이가 커졌기 때문이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Which INITIAL flight deck indications should a pilot be aware of when a headwind shears to a calm wind?

choices.text: Indicated airspeed decreases, aircraft pitches up, and altitude decreases.
Indicated airspeed increases, aircraft pitches down, and altitude increases.
Indicated airspeed decreases, aircraft pitches down, and altitude decreases.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Headwind에서 calm으로 급변하면 headwind component가 감소해 IAS와 성능이 떨어지고, 항공기는 nose-down 경향과 고도손실을 보인다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Which condition would INITIALLY cause the indicated airspeed and pitch to increase and the sink rate to decrease?

choices.text: Sudden decrease in a headwind component.
Tailwind which suddenly increases in velocity.
Sudden increase in a headwind component.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Tailwind에서 headwind로 바뀌는 등 headwind component가 갑자기 증가하면 처음에는 IAS, pitch, altitude가 증가해 성능이 좋아진다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Which INITIAL flight deck indications should a pilot be aware of when a constant tailwind shears to a calm wind?

choices.text: Altitude increases; pitch and indicated airspeed decrease.
Altitude, pitch, and indicated airspeed decrease.
Altitude, pitch, and indicated airspeed increase.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 일정한 tailwind가 calm으로 바뀌면 상대적으로 IAS가 증가하고 성능이 좋아져 pitch-up 및 고도상승 경향이 나타난다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Which wind-shear condition results in an increase in airspeed?
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Tailwind가 headwind로 급변하면 초기에는 IAS가 증가하고 항공기가 pitch-up하며 고도가 증가한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Which wind-shear condition results in a loss of airspeed?
questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Headwind component가 감소하거나 tailwind가 증가하면 초기에는 IAS 감소, nose-down 경향, 고도감소가 나타난다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Which airplane performance characteristics should be recognized during takeoff when encountering a tailwind shear that increases in intensity?

choices.text: Loss of, or diminished, airspeed performance.
Increased climb performance immediately after takeoff.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Tailwind shear가 강해질수록 IAS와 항공기 성능이 감소하므로 이를 보상하려면 더 많은 thrust가 필요하다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Thrust is being managed to maintain desired indicated airspeed and the glide slope is being flown. Which characteristics should be observed when a tailwind shears to a constant headwind?

choices.text: PITCH ATTITUDE: Increases. VERTICAL SPEED: Increases. INDICATED AIRSPEED: Decreases, then increases to approach speed.
PITCH ATTITUDE: Increases. VERTICAL SPEED: Decreases. INDICATED AIRSPEED: Increases, then decreases.
PITCH ATTITUDE: Decreases. VERTICAL SPEED: Decreases. INDICATED AIRSPEED: Decreases, then increases to approach speed.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Tailwind가 일정한 headwind로 바뀌면 IAS는 처음 증가한 뒤 다시 감소할 수 있고 pitch attitude는 증가한다. 처음에는 감속을 위해 thrust를 줄였다가 일정한 headwind에서 glide slope를 유지하려면 다시 thrust를 높이게 된다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: In comparison to an approach in a moderate headwind, which is an indication of a possible wind shear due to a decreasing headwind when descending on the glide slope?
questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Decreasing headwind shear는 IAS와 성능을 낮추고 항공기가 nose-down하려는 경향을 만든다. 회복하려면 더 높은 pitch attitude가 필요하다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What is the recommended technique to counter the loss of airspeed and resultant lift from wind shear?

choices.text: Lower the pitch attitude and regain lost airspeed.
Avoid overstressing the aircraft, “pitch to airspeed,” and apply maximum power.
Maintain, or increase, pitch attitude and accept the lower-than-normal airspeed indications.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. IAS와 lift가 감소한다면 increasing tailwind 또는 decreasing headwind shear의 징후이다. 회복 시 정상보다 낮은 IAS 표시를 감수하더라도 pitch attitude를 유지하거나 증가시키는 것이 중요하다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: When thrust is being used to manage the glide slope, which characteristics should be observed when a headwind shears to a constant tailwind?

choices.text: Decrease in pitch, increase in vertical speed, and loss of airspeed followed by on speed indications.
Decrease in pitch, decrease in vertical speed, and increase in airspeed.
Increase in pitch, decrease in vertical speed, and loss of airspeed.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Increasing tailwind 또는 decreasing headwind shear는 IAS와 성능을 떨어뜨리고 항공기가 trim speed를 되찾으려 nose-down할 수 있으므로 미리 대비해야 한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Turbulence encountered above 15,000 feet AGL, not associated with cloud formations, should be reported as
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 15,000 ft AGL 이상에서 cumuliform cloud와 관계없이 만나는 고고도 난류는 clear-air turbulence(CAT)로 보고한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What is a likely location of clear air turbulences?

choices.text: In an upper trough on the polar side of a jet stream.
Near a ridge aloft on the equatorial side of a high-pressure flow.
Downstream of the equatorial side of a jet stream.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. CAT는 jet stream의 polar side, 특히 깊어지는 upper trough 부근에서 잘 발생한다. 이곳에서는 강한 wind shear와 cold/warm advection이 형성된다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What action is appropriate when encountering the first ripple of reported clear air turbulence (CAT)?

choices.text: Extend flaps to decrease wind loading.
Extend gear to provide more drag and increase stability.
Adjust airspeed to that recommended for rough air.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. CAT의 첫 흔들림을 만나면 rough-air recommended speed로 감속하는 것이 적절하며, 이는 난류 중 항공기에 가해지는 구조하중을 줄인다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Clear air turbulence (CAT) associated with a mountain wave may extend as far as

choices.text: 1,000 miles or more downstream of the mountain.
100 miles or more upwind of the mountain.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Mountain wave CAT는 산 정상에서 tropopause 위 약 5,000 ft까지, 그리고 산의 downwind 방향으로 100 mi 이상 이어질 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Under what conditions would clear air turbulence (CAT) most likely be encountered?

choices.text: When constant pressure charts show 20-knot isotachs less than 60 NM apart.
When constant pressure charts show 60-knot isotachs less than 20 NM apart.
When a sharp trough is moving at a speed less than 20 knots.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Constant pressure chart에서 20-kt isotach 간격이 60 NM 미만이면 CAT를 일으킬 충분한 horizontal shear가 있는 것으로 본다. 주로 jet stream의 polar side에서 나타난다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: If severe turbulence is encountered, which procedure is recommended?
questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Severe turbulence에서는 일정고도를 억지로 유지하려는 조작이 구조하중을 크게 늘린다. 일정한 attitude를 유지하고 updraft/downdraft에 따라 고도가 변하도록 두는 편이 하중을 줄인다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What action is recommended when encountering turbulence due to a wind shift associated with a sharp pressure trough?

choices.text: Establish a straight course across the storm area.
Climb or descend to a smoother level.
Increase speed to get out of the trough as soon as possible.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Sharp pressure trough line과 관련된 급격한 wind shift에서 난류를 만나면 storm area를 가로질러 직선으로 통과하는 것이 좋다. 난류대가 보통 trough와 평행하므로 통과 시간을 줄일 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Which action is recommended if jet stream turbulence is encountered with a direct headwind or tailwind?

choices.text: Increase airspeed to get out of the area quickly.
Change course to fly on the polar side of the jet stream.
Change altitude or course to avoid a possible elongated turbulent area.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 직접적인 headwind 또는 tailwind를 동반한 jet-stream turbulence를 만나면 고도나 course를 바꾸는 것이 좋다. 이런 난류대는 바람 방향으로 길고 수직으로 얕고 좁다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Which action is recommended regarding an altitude change to get out of jet stream turbulence?

choices.text: Descend if ambient temperature is falling.
Descend if ambient temperature is rising.
Maintain altitude if ambient temperature is not changing.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Sloping tropopause 관련 turbulence에서는 기온 변화를 관찰한다. 가장 낮은 온도 지점이 tropopause 통과점이며, stratospheric side의 temperature-change zone에서 난류가 더 강하다. 기온이 내려가면 강하, 올라가면 상승하면 난류대 이탈에 도움이 된다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: You can expect turbulence when winds exceed
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 험준한 산악을 넘을 때 산을 가로지르는 풍속이 약 40 kt를 초과하면 severe turbulence 가능성을 예상해야 한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: The threshold windspeed in the jet stream for clear air turbulence is generally considered to be
questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Jet stream에서 CAT 가능성을 고려하는 기준풍속은 약 110 kt이다. 그러나 CAT를 직접 만드는 것은 풍속 자체보다 고도·위치 간 풍속차, 즉 wind shear이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Clear air turbulence (CAT) can be found
questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. CAT는 기본적으로 convective cloud 밖에서 만나는 난류이며 cirrus 및 standing lenticular cloud 내부·주변 난류도 포함해 표현한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Moderate CAT is considered likely when the vertical wind shear is

choices.text: 15 knots per 2,000 feet or greater and/or the horizontal wind shear is 40 knots per 150 miles or greater.
10 knots per 1,000 feet or greater and/or the horizontal wind shear is 50 knots per 150 miles or greater.
5 knots per 1,000 feet or greater and/or the horizontal wind shear is 40 knots per 150 miles or greater.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Moderate CAT 가능성은 vertical wind shear가 1,000 ft당 5 kt 이상 및/또는 horizontal shear가 150 mi당 40 kt 이상일 때 높아진다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: When encountering severe turbulence, you should

choices.text: Slow to turbulent air penetration speed.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Severe turbulence를 만나면 turbulent-air penetration speed 또는 VA로 감속해야 한다. 더 빠른 속도에서는 난류·조작 시 구조하중이 과도해질 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Which is one of the three key elements in an effective clear air turbulence (CAT) Avoidance System?
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 효과적인 CAT 회피체계의 핵심은 적절한 초기·정기 훈련, 전담 planning/dispatch 기능, 그리고 충분히 지원되는 PIREP/communications 체계이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What is the expected duration of an individual microburst?

choices.text: Five minutes with maximum winds lasting approximately 2 to 4 minutes.
One microburst may continue for as long as an hour.
Seldom longer than 15 minutes from the time the burst strikes the ground until dissipation.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 개별 microburst는 지면 도달부터 소멸까지 보통 15분을 넘지 않는다. 수평풍은 첫 5분 동안 증가하며 최대강도는 약 2~4분 지속된다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Maximum downdrafts in a microburst encounter may be as strong as
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Microburst downdraft는 6,000 ft/min까지 강할 수 있고 지면 부근 수평풍은 45 kt에 달해 headwind-tailwind 사이 총 90 kt wind shear를 만들 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Maximum downdrafts in a microburst encounter may be as strong as
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Microburst는 최대 약 6,000 fpm downdraft와 지면 부근 45 kt 수평풍을 만들 수 있어 약 90 kt의 wind shear가 발생할 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What is the expected duration of an individual microburst?

choices.text: Two minutes with maximum winds lasting approximately 1 minute.
One microburst may continue for as long as 2 to 4 hours.
Seldom longer than 15 minutes from the time the burst strikes the ground until dissipation.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Microburst의 전체 수명은 보통 15분 이내이며 첫 5분에 수평풍이 강화되고 최대풍은 약 2~4분 유지된다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Doppler wind measurements indicate that the windspeed change a pilot may expect when flying through the peak intensity of a microburst is approximately
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 평균 microburst의 최대강도 지점을 통과할 때 약 45 kt의 wind-speed change가 예상되지만 실제로는 거의 100 kt 차이가 관측된 사례도 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: An aircraft that encounters a headwind of 45 knots, within a microburst, may expect a total shear across the microburst of
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Microburst 한쪽의 headwind가 45 kt라면 반대쪽에는 약 45 kt tailwind가 있을 수 있어 통과 항공기는 총 90 kt shear를 경험할 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: An aircraft that encounters a headwind of 40 knots, within a microburst, may expect a total shear across the microburst of
questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Microburst에서 headwind 40 kt에서 반대편 tailwind 40 kt로 바뀌면 총 wind shear는 약 80 kt이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: As you approach an airport to land, you observe a convective cloud over the airport with virga below it. This could indicate
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Virga는 강수가 지면에 닿기 전에 증발하는 현상이다. 증발냉각으로 주변 공기가 차갑고 무거워져 강한 downdraft와 때로 microburst를 만들 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Hazardous vortex turbulence that might be encountered behind large aircraft is created only when that aircraft is
questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. 날개 위 낮은 압력과 아래 높은 압력의 차이 때문에 공기가 wingtip 주위로 말려 올라가며 뒤쪽으로 두 개의 반대방향 회전 vortex가 형성된다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: How does the wake turbulence vortex circulate around each wingtip?

choices.text: Inward, upward, and around the wingtip.
Counterclockwise when viewed from behind the aircraft.
Outward, upward, and around the wingtip.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 날개 아래의 높은 압력 공기는 wingtip 바깥쪽·위쪽으로 이동해 위쪽의 낮은 압력 영역으로 말려 들어간다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Which statement is true concerning the wake turbulence produced by a large transport aircraft?

choices.text: Vortices can be avoided by flying 300 feet below and behind the flight path of the generating aircraft.
The vortex characteristics of any given aircraft may be altered by extending the flaps or changing the speed.
Wake turbulence behind a propeller-driven aircraft is negligible because jet engine thrust is a necessary factor in the formation of vortices.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Wake turbulence 강도는 발생 항공기의 weight, speed, wing shape에 좌우되며 flap 등 wing configuration과 속도 변화에 따라 vortex 특성이 달라진다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Which flight conditions of a large jet airplane create the most severe flight hazard by generating wingtip vortices of the greatest strength?

choices.text: Heavy, slow, gear and flaps up.
Heavy, slow, gear and flaps down.
Heavy, fast, gear and flaps down.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. 가장 강한 wingtip vortex는 항공기가 heavy, slow, clean(gear/flaps up) 상태일 때 발생한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Wingtip vortices created by large aircraft tend to

choices.text: sink below the aircraft generating the turbulence.
rise from the surface to traffic pattern altitude.
accumulate and remain for a period of time at the point where the takeoff roll began.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. 대형항공기의 vortex는 뒤쪽에서 분당 수백 ft로 가라앉다가 시간·거리와 함께 약해진다. 선행 항공기 flight path 이상에서 비행하고 그 뒤·아래를 피해야 한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What effect would a light crosswind have on the wingtip vortices generated by a large airplane that has just taken off?

choices.text: The upwind vortex will tend to remain on the runway longer than the downwind vortex.
A crosswind will rapidly dissipate the strength of both vortices.
The downwind vortex will tend to remain on the runway longer than the upwind vortex.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Vortex가 지면 약 200 ft 이내로 내려오면 각 wing 방향으로 지상에서 약 2~3 kt로 옆으로 이동한다. Crosswind에서는 downwind vortex는 빨리 날아가지만 upwind vortex는 활주로에 더 오래 남는다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What wind condition prolongs the hazards of wake turbulence on a landing runway for the longest period of time?
questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. 약한 quartering tailwind는 선행기의 vortex를 touchdown zone 앞으로 밀고 upwind vortex를 활주로에 오래 남게 할 수 있어 특히 위험하다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: To avoid the wingtip vortices of a departing jet airplane during takeoff, the pilot should

choices.text: lift off at a point well past the jet airplane’s flight path.
climb above and stay upwind of the jet airplane’s flight path.
remain below the flight path of the jet airplane.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. 출발 jet의 rotation point부터 강한 vortex가 생성된다. 뒤따라 이륙할 때는 그 지점보다 먼저 rotate하고 선행 jet의 flight path보다 위쪽·upwind에 머물며 뒤·아래를 가로지르는 heading을 피한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: If you take off behind a heavy jet that has just landed, you should plan to lift off

choices.text: prior to the point where the jet touched down.
beyond the point where the jet touched down.
at the point where the jet touched down and on the upwind edge of the runway.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. 방금 착륙한 heavy jet 뒤에서 이륙할 때는 최소 2분 간격을 두고, 선행기의 touchdown point보다 뒤쪽에서 lift off하도록 계획한다. Nose gear가 접지해 lift가 사라지면 vortex 생성도 끝난다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: To allow pilots of in-trail lighter aircraft to make flight path adjustments to avoid wake turbulence, pilots of heavy and large jet aircraft should fly

choices.text: below the established glidepath and slightly to either side of the on-course centerline.
on the established glidepath and on the approach course centerline or runway centerline extended.
above the established glidepath and slightly downwind of the on-course centerline.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. 강한 wake를 만드는 heavy/large jet은 뒤따르는 경항공기가 회피할 수 있도록 established glide path와 approach course centerline 또는 runway extended centerline을 따라 비행해야 한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Your flight takes you in the path of a large aircraft. In order to avoid the vortices you should fly

choices.text: at the same altitude as the large aircraft.
below the altitude of the large aircraft.
above the flight path of the large aircraft.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 대형항공기 뒤에서는 선행기의 flight path 이상을 유지해야 한다. Wingtip vortex는 아래로 가라앉으므로 선행기 뒤·아래에서 가장 위험하다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Hypoxia is the result of which of these conditions?

choices.text: Excessive carbon dioxide in the bloodstream.
Limited oxygen reaching the heart muscles.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Hypoxia는 뇌와 다른 장기의 기능을 떨어뜨릴 정도로 몸에 산소가 부족한 상태이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What causes hypoxia?

choices.text: Excessive carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.
An increase in nitrogen content of the air at high altitudes.
A decrease of oxygen partial pressure.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 고도 노출에 의한 hypoxia는 고도에서 barometric pressure가 낮아져 폐가 흡수할 수 있는 산소량이 줄어들기 때문에 발생한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Loss of cabin pressure may result in hypoxia because as cabin altitude increases

choices.text: the percentage of nitrogen in the air is increased.
the percentage of oxygen in the air is decreased.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 고도가 높아질수록 대기압이 낮아져 산소의 partial pressure가 감소하고 폐에서 흡수되는 산소량도 줄어 hypoxia가 발생한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: A pilot making a blood donation in order to help a sick associate should be aware that for several weeks

choices.text: sufficient oxygen may not reach the cells in the body.
fewer oxygen molecules will be available to the respiratory membranes.
the ability of the body tissues to effectively use oxygen is decreased.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. 헌혈 후에는 산소를 운반할 혈액량이 부족해져 hypemic hypoxia가 발생할 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What is a symptom of carbon monoxide poisoning?

choices.text: Pain and cramping of the hands and feet.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Carbon monoxide poisoning의 대표 증상은 두통, 졸림, 어지러움이며, 항공기에서는 고장 난 cabin heater가 원인이 될 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What is the effect of alcohol consumption on functions of the body?

choices.text: Alcohol has an adverse effect, especially as altitude increases.
Alcohol has little effect if followed by an ounce of black coffee for every ounce of alcohol.
Small amounts of alcohol in the human system increase judgment and decision-making abilities.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Alcohol은 비행능력을 떨어뜨리고 소량이라도 spatial disorientation과 hypoxia에 더 취약하게 만든다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Pilots should remember the alcohol in one beer can be detected for as long as
questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. 맥주 한 병 정도의 alcohol도 최소 약 3시간 동안 호흡이나 혈액에서 검출될 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Pilots should know

choices.text: it takes a minimum of four ounces of liquor to cause impairment.
as little as one beer can cause impairment.
it takes a minimum of eight ounces of wine to cause impairment.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. 맥주 한 병 정도의 적은 alcohol도 비행능력을 저하시킬 수 있고 최소 약 3시간 동안 검출될 수 있다. 규정상 '8 hours bottle to throttle'을 기억해야 하며 안전상 12~24시간 이상의 간격이 더 바람직하다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Consumption of alcohol

choices.text: can severely impair a person for more than 8 hours.
is of no concern in aviation after 8 hours regardless of amount consumed.
in small amounts has no effect on judgment and decision-making.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. 적당량의 alcohol도 대사가 느려 8시간 뒤까지 영향을 줄 수 있고, 혈중 alcohol이 사라진 뒤에도 hangover로 수행능력이 오랫동안 저하될 수 있다. 최소 8시간 규정을 지키고 가능하면 12~24시간 간격을 두는 것이 안전하다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Alcohol renders a pilot more susceptible to
questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Alcohol과 비행은 치명적인 조합이 될 수 있다. 규정은 음주 후 8시간 이내 또는 alcohol 영향 하에서 승무원 임무를 금지하며, alcohol은 disorientation과 hypoxia 감수성도 높인다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: You attended a party last night and you consumed several glasses of wine. You are planning to fly your aircraft home and have been careful to make sure 8 hours have passed since your last alcoholic drink. You can make the flight now only if you are not under the influence of alcohol and your blood alcohol level is
questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. 14 CFR Part 91은 음주 후 최소 8시간이 지나야 하고 혈중 alcohol 농도가 0.04% 미만이어야 한다고 요구한다. 둘 중 하나라도 충족하지 못하면 비행할 수 없다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: While experiencing a hangover, a pilot

choices.text: will have impaired motor and mental responses.
is no longer under the influence of alcohol.
may experience discomfort, but no impairment.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Hangover 상태에서도 운동·인지 반응 저하가 남아 있으므로 조종사는 여전히 alcohol의 영향을 받고 있는 것으로 보아야 한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Which is a common symptom of hyperventilation?
questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Hyperventilation은 스트레스 등으로 과도하게 호흡해 CO2를 지나치게 배출하는 상태이다. 어지러움, 질식감, 졸림, 손발 저림, 차가운 느낌 등이 나타날 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Which would most likely result in hyperventilation?

choices.text: An extremely slow rate of breathing and insufficient oxygen.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. 과호흡은 무의식적으로 호흡량이 과도하게 증가해 체내 CO2가 지나치게 빠져나가는 현상으로, lightheadedness, suffocation, drowsiness, tingling, coolness 등의 증상이 나타난다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Scanning procedures for effective collision avoidance should constitute

choices.text: looking outside for 15 seconds, then inside for 5 seconds, then repeat.
1 minute inside scanning, then 1 minute outside scanning, then repeat.
looking outside every 30 seconds except in radar contact when outside scanning is unnecessary.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. VFR에서 cockpit 내부 시각작업은 외부 scan 시간의 약 1/4~1/3 이하가 적절하다. 예를 들어 외부를 16초 scan할 때 instrument panel은 약 4~5초 이내로 본다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What is the most effective way to use the eyes during night flight?

choices.text: Look only at far away, dim lights.
Scan slowly to permit offcenter viewing.
Concentrate directly on each object for a few seconds.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. 야간에는 눈이 중심부보다 약간 벗어난 곳의 물체를 더 잘 감지하므로 천천히 scan하고 off-center viewing을 활용해야 한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Which observed target aircraft would be of most concern with respect to collision avoidance?

choices.text: One which appears to be ahead and moving from left to right at high speed.
One which appears to be ahead and moving from right to left at slow speed.
One which appears to be ahead with no lateral or vertical movement and is increasing in size.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 상대운동 없이 한 scan quadrant에 계속 머무는 항공기는 collision course일 가능성이 높다. 좌우·상하 움직임이 없는데 크기만 커지면 즉시 회피해야 한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: When using the Earth’s horizon as a reference point to determine the relative position of other aircraft, most concern would be for aircraft

choices.text: above the horizon and increasing in size.
on the horizon with little relative movement.
on the horizon and increasing in size.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 다른 항공기가 horizon 위면 보통 더 높은 경로, 아래면 더 낮은 경로이다. Horizon 부근에서 상대운동이 거의 없고 크기가 커진다면 같은 고도에서 접근하는 충돌위험이 있을 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: A pilot is more subject to spatial disorientation when

choices.text: ignoring or overcoming the sensations of muscles and inner ear.
eyes are moved often in the process of cross-checking the flight instruments.
body sensations are used to interpret flight attitudes.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Spatial disorientation은 여러 감각기관이 뇌에 잘못된 정보를 보내 일시적인 방향·자세 혼란이 생기는 상태이다. 신체감각으로 항공기 자세를 판단할수록 위험이 커진다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Which procedure is recommended to prevent or overcome spatial disorientation?

choices.text: Reduce head and eye movement to the greatest possible extent.
Rely entirely on the indications of the flight instruments.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Spatial disorientation을 극복하는 가장 좋은 방법은 신체감각을 믿지 말고 flight instrument와 이용 가능한 ground reference에 전적으로 의존하는 것이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: When making an approach to a narrower-than-usual runway, without VASI assistance, the pilot should be aware that the approach

choices.text: altitude may be higher than it appears.
altitude may be lower than it appears.
may result in leveling off too high and landing hard.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. 평소보다 좁은 활주로는 실제보다 더 높은 고도에 있는 것처럼 느끼게 해 조종사가 낮은 접근을 하게 만들 수 있으며, 장애물 충돌·short landing 위험이 생긴다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: The illusion of being in a nose-up attitude which may occur during a rapid acceleration takeoff is known as
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 이륙 중 급가속은 nose-up한 것 같은 착각을 만들 수 있다. 이를 보정하려고 밀면 실제로 nose-low 또는 dive attitude에 들어갈 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: While making prolonged constant rate turns under IFR conditions, an abrupt head movement can create the illusion of rotation on an entirely different axis. This is known as
questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. 장시간 일정률 선회 중 갑자기 머리를 크게 움직이면 Coriolis illusion으로 전혀 다른 축의 회전감을 느낄 수 있다. IFR에서 긴 선회 중에는 갑작스럽고 큰 머리 움직임을 피해야 한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: In the dark, a stationary light will appear to move when stared at for a period of time. This illusion is known as
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 어두운 곳에서 고정된 불빛을 오래 바라보면 움직이는 것처럼 보이는 autokinesis가 생길 수 있으며, 그 불빛에 항공기를 맞추려다 자세를 잃을 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: When making a landing over darkened or featureless terrain such as water or snow, a pilot should be aware of the possibility of illusion. The approach may appear to be too
questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. 물·어두운 지형·눈 덮인 featureless terrain처럼 지상 특징이 없으면 실제보다 높게 느껴져 필요 이상으로 낮은 접근을 할 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Haze can give the illusion that the aircraft is

choices.text: closer to the runway than it actually is.
farther from the runway than it actually is.
the same distance from the runway as when there is no restriction to visibility.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Atmospheric haze는 활주로가 실제보다 더 멀리 있는 것처럼 보이게 해 조종사가 낮은 접근을 하도록 만들 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Sudden penetration of fog can create the illusion of
questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Fog 안으로 진입하면 pitch-up한 것처럼 느끼는 착각이 생길 수 있고, 이를 잘못 보정하면 접근각을 갑자기 가파르게 만들 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Penetrating fog while flying an approach at night, you might experience the illusion of
questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. 빛의 굴절(refractory effects)은 nose-high attitude로 느끼게 하는 시각착각을 만들 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: The illusion associated with landing on a narrower than usual runway may result in the pilot flying a

choices.text: lower approach with the risk of striking objects along the approach path or landing short.
slower approach with the risk of reducing airspeed below VSO or landing hard.
higher approach with the risk of leveling out high and landing hard or overshooting the runway.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. 좁은 활주로는 실제보다 높은 고도에 있는 것처럼 느끼게 하므로 접근을 지나치게 낮게 해 장애물 충돌이나 runway short landing을 유발할 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What illusion, if any, can rain on the windscreen create?
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Windshield의 rain은 실제보다 runway 위에서 더 높게 있는 것처럼 보이게 해 조종사가 낮은 접근을 하도록 만들 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: You have just touched down hard on a narrower than usual runway at night. You realize you just experienced
questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Hard landing은 늦은 flare와 연관될 수 있으며, 좁은 활주로가 실제보다 높게 느끼게 하는 runway-width illusion이 원인이 될 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Staring at static light in the darkness can create the illusion of

choices.text: autokinesis which could lead to loss of control.
halo vision and night vision loss.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Autokinesis는 어두운 곳의 정지된 불빛을 몇 초 이상 응시하면 움직이는 것처럼 보이는 현상이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: You just touched down faster than planned in haze on a runway at night. You realize you have just experienced
questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Haze는 runway가 더 멀리 있는 것처럼 느끼게 해 낮은 접근을 만들고, 정상보다 빠른 속도로 갑자기 touchdown할 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: You just touched down hard in the rain on a narrower than usual runway at night. You have just experienced
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Windshield rain과 narrow-runway illusion은 모두 실제보다 높게 느끼게 하므로 조종사가 낮은 접근을 해 hard landing으로 이어질 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Human behavior

choices.text: rarely results in accidents unless deliberate actions are performed.
causes three out of four accidents.
is well understood, so behavioral induced accidents are exceedingly rare occurrences.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Human behavior 연구는 사람이 왜 특정 방식으로 행동하는지 이해해 항공 human error의 결과를 줄이는 데 사용된다. 오류 자체를 완전히 제거할 수는 없으므로 예측 가능한 오류를 훈련과 시스템으로 관리하는 것이 핵심이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Risk management, as part of the aeronautical decision making (ADM) process, relies on which features to reduce the risks associated with each flight?

choices.text: Application of stress management and risk element procedures.
The mental process of analyzing all information in a particular situation and making a timely decision on what action to take.
Situational awareness, problem recognition, and good judgment.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Risk management는 ADM의 일부로 situational awareness, problem recognition, good judgment를 이용해 각 비행의 위험을 줄이는 과정이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Risk is increased when flightcrew members

choices.text: fail to monitor automated navigation systems.
allocate time to verify expected performance of automated systems.
question the performance of each other’s duties.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. 시스템을 감시하지 않고 결과를 확인하지 않으면 조종사는 운항에서 분리되어 'passenger in command'처럼 complacency에 빠질 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: The most important key to risk management is

choices.text: the sense of security provided by experience.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. External pressure 관리는 risk management에서 특히 중요하다. 시간·일정 압박은 조종사가 다른 모든 위험요인을 무시하게 만들 수 있고 많은 사고에 관여한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Aeronautical decision making (ADM) can be defined as a

choices.text: mental process of analyzing all available information in a particular situation, making a timely decision on what action to take, and when to take the action.
decision making process which relies on good judgment to reduce risks associated with each flight.
systematic approach to the mental process used by pilots to consistently determine the best course of action in response to a given set of circumstances.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. ADM은 주어진 상황에서 최선의 행동을 일관되게 선택하기 위한 체계적인 mental decision-making process이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: The aeronautical decision making (ADM) process identifies several steps involved in good decision making. One of these steps is

choices.text: making a rational evaluation of the required actions.
identifying personal attitudes hazardous to safe flight.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. ADM에는 여러 좋은 의사결정 단계가 포함되며 그중 하나가 안전비행에 위험한 개인의 hazardous attitude를 식별하는 것이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Examples of classic behavioral traps that experienced pilots may fall into are to

choices.text: promote situational awareness and then necessary changes in behavior.
complete a flight as planned, please passengers, meet schedules, and “get the job done.”
assume additional responsibilities and assert PIC authority.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. 경험 많은 조종사도 계획대로 비행을 끝내려는 강박, 승객을 만족시키려는 욕구, 일정 준수 압박, '일을 끝내야 한다'는 집착 같은 classic behavioral trap에 빠질 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: All experienced pilots have fallen prey to, or have been tempted by, one or more of these dangerous tendencies or behavior problems at some time in their career. Select the answer that best describes these tendencies.

choices.text: Deficiencies in instrument skills and knowledge of aircraft systems or limitations.
Peer pressure, loss of situational awareness, and operating with inadequate fuel reserves.
Performance deficiencies due to stress from human factors, such as fatigue, illness, or emotional problems.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. 경험 많은 조종사도 peer pressure, situational awareness 상실, 불충분한 fuel reserve 운항 같은 위험한 행동경향에 빠질 수 있으므로 이를 인식하고 제거해야 한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: An experienced pilot trying to meet a schedule

choices.text: can expect the flight crew to alert them to problems or areas of concern.
will always err on the side of caution.
can fail to perceive operational pitfalls.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 일정을 맞추려는 distraction은 조종사와 승무원이 중요한 식별요소를 놓치게 해 흔한 operational pitfall로 이어질 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: In order to gain a realistic perspective on one’s attitude toward flying, a pilot should

choices.text: understand the need to complete the flight.
obtain both realistic and thorough flight instruction during training.
take a Self-Assessment Hazardous Attitude Inventory Test.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 자신의 비행 태도를 현실적으로 평가하려면 Self-Assessment Hazardous Attitude Inventory Test를 활용할 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Hazardous attitudes occur to every pilot to some degree at some time. What are some of these hazardous attitudes?

choices.text: Antiauthority, impulsivity, macho, resignation, and invulnerability.
Poor situational awareness, snap judgments, and lack of a decision making process.
Poor risk management and lack of stress management.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. ADM의 5가지 hazardous attitude는 antiauthority, impulsivity, invulnerability, macho, resignation이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Name some hazardous attitudes that can affect your judgment during the aeronautical decision making (ADM) process.
questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. 의사결정을 해치는 대표 5가지 hazardous attitude는 반권위적 태도, 충동성, 불사신적 사고, macho, resignation이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What should a pilot do when recognizing a thought as hazardous?

choices.text: Correct this hazardous thought by making a thorough risk assessment.
Label the thought as hazardous and then correct that thought by stating the corresponding antidote.
Avoid allowing this hazardous thought to develop.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Hazardous thought를 인식하면 먼저 위험한 생각이라고 label하고 해당 attitude의 antidote를 말해 교정해야 한다. 각 antidote를 미리 암기해 즉시 떠올릴 수 있어야 한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: In the aeronautical decision making (ADM) process, what is the first step in neutralizing a hazardous attitude?

choices.text: Recognizing the invulnerability of the situation.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Hazardous attitude는 먼저 위험한 생각임을 인식한 뒤 안전한 행동으로 redirect함으로써 효과적으로 상쇄할 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Hazardous attitudes which contribute to poor pilot judgment can be effectively counteracted by

choices.text: taking meaningful steps to be more assertive with attitudes.
early recognition of these hazardous attitudes.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. 위험한 생각을 발견하면 hazardous라고 명확히 인식·label하고 그에 맞는 antidote를 적용해 태도를 바꿔야 한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: What is the antidote for a pilot with a “macho” attitude?

choices.text: I’m not helpless. I can make a difference.
Follow the rules. They are usually right.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Macho attitude는 다른 사람에게 자신을 증명하려고 불필요한 위험을 감수하는 태도이다. Antidote는 'Taking chances is foolish.'이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Success in reducing stress associated with a crisis on the flight deck begins with

choices.text: eliminating the more serious life and flight deck stress issues.
knowing the exact cause of the stress.
assessing stress areas in one’s personal life.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Cockpit crisis management의 stress를 줄이려면 먼저 자신의 삶 전반에 존재하는 stress를 개인적으로 평가하는 것이 중요하다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: An air carrier aircraft flown into the ground while the crew is troubleshooting a landing gear fault is an example of
questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Eastern Airlines Flight 401 사고는 landing gear 문제에 집중하다 crew가 situational awareness를 잃어 발생한 대표 사례로, 숙련된 승무원도 경계를 놓치면 SA를 상실할 수 있음을 보여준다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: To help manage flight deck stress, a pilot should

choices.text: think of life stress situations that are similar to those in flying.
try to relax and think rationally at the first sign of stress.
avoid situations that will degrade the ability to handle flight deck responsibilities.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Flight deck stress를 관리하려면 stress의 첫 징후에서 스스로 긴장을 풀고 합리적으로 생각하도록 훈련해야 한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: The DECIDE process consists of six elements to help provide a pilot a logical way of approaching aeronautical decision making. These elements are to

choices.text: estimate, determine, choose, identify, detect, and evaluate.
determine, evaluate, choose, identify, do, and eliminate.
detect, estimate, choose, identify, do, and evaluate.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. DECIDE model은 Detect, Estimate, Choose, Identify, Do, Evaluate의 6단계로 의사결정을 논리적으로 진행하게 한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: When a recently certificated pilot decides to not wait any longer for the fog and low ceilings to lift, this pilot may be exhibiting the hazardous
questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. 기상이 좋아질 근거가 없는데 'I can do it'이라고 판단해 계속 시도하는 것은 macho attitude의 예이며 성별과 관계없이 나타날 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: An air carrier crew fixated on completing the last flight of a four day trip often may exhibit
questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. 정해진 시간에 집에 도착하는 등 특정 목표에 집착해 대안 행동을 무시하는 현상을 get-there-itis라 하며 조종사의 판단을 손상시킨다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Automatic Decision-Making is
questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Automatic decision-making은 훈련과 경험에 기반한 반사적 의사결정으로, 분석적 판단을 할 시간이 없는 비상상황에서 주로 사용된다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: When a pilot believes advanced avionics enable operations closer to personal or environmental limits,

choices.text: greater utilization of the aircraft is achieved.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. 첨단 avionics가 있다고 해서 안전을 과신해서는 안 된다. Judgment와 ADM은 기술을 안전으로 연결하는 역할을 하며, 조종사·항공기·환경·외부압력 조건에 따라 personal minimum의 safety buffer를 조정해야 한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Automation in aircraft has proven

choices.text: to present new hazards in its limitations.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Automation은 안전성을 높이지만 동시에 오류를 숨기거나 complacency를 만들 수 있다. 사람은 신뢰도가 높은 자동시스템을 수동적으로 감시하는 데 취약하므로 automation이 situational awareness를 높이기도 하고 낮추기도 한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: A pilot’s attitude

choices.text: has no effect on aviation decisions.
has no effect on pilot perceptions.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Hazardous attitude를 인식하면 그것을 위험하다고 label한 뒤 대응 antidote를 적용해 올바른 행동으로 redirect해야 한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: When a pilot fixates on the original goal or destination is
questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Get-there-itis는 원래 목표나 목적지에 집착해 다른 대안을 무시함으로써 조종사의 판단을 손상시키는 성향이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: The lighter workloads associated with glass (digital) flight instrumentation

choices.text: are instrumental in decreasing flightcrew fatigue.
have proven to increase safety in operations.
may lead to complacency by the flightcrew.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Glass cockpit의 automation과 높은 SA 기능은 안전성을 크게 높일 수 있지만 workload 감소가 complacency를 만들 수 있다. 사람은 자동시스템의 드문 오류를 감시하는 데 약하므로 고신뢰 automation일수록 적극적 monitoring이 중요하다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Attitude is a motivational predisposition to

choices.text: respond to people, situations, or events in a given manner.
frame all circumstances in various predetermined scenarios.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Attitude는 특정 사람·상황·사건에 일정한 방식으로 반응하려는 동기적 성향이며 의사결정의 질에 직접 영향을 준다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Not cross-checking the heading indicator with the runway for correct runway heading and alignment agreement is an example of
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 목표·일정 압박은 안전에 악영향을 줄 수 있다. 예를 들어 시간을 아끼려고 runway heading과 실제 alignment를 확인하지 않으면 wrong-runway takeoff로 이어질 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Experienced pilots, as compared to inexperienced pilots, are more likely to make automatic decisions which culminate in

choices.text: not being tempted by falling prey to one or more operational pitfalls.
the exercise of proper judgment and making correct decisions.
classic behavioral traps which lead to accidents and incidents.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 숙련된 조종사도 계획대로 비행을 끝내려는 강박, 승객 만족 욕구, 일정 압박, 'get the job done' 집착 같은 classic behavioral trap에 빠질 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Working 6 days in a row with 14 hours a day waiting, flying, waiting, flying, and waiting will leave you

choices.text: with a minor case of acute fatigue.
with a case of chronic fatigue.
well rested after an 8-hour rest period.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Acute fatigue는 단기간의 피로로, 과도한 활동·흥분·수면부족 뒤 흔히 느끼는 정상적인 일시적 피로이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Flightcrew members must receive fatigue education and awareness training

choices.text: with all required air carrier dispatcher and every flightcrew member training activity.
annually for flightcrew member schedulers, operational control individuals and flightcrew members and dispatchers.
annually for flight crewmembers and every 24 months for dispatchers, flightcrew member schedulers, and operational control individuals.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Certificate holder는 flightcrew, dispatcher, scheduler, operational control 및 관련 관리자 등을 대상으로 Administrator 승인 fatigue education/awareness training을 매년 제공해야 한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: One of the most dangerous hazards in aviation is
questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Acute fatigue가 있다면 비행하지 않는 것이 최선이다. Flight deck에서 피로가 발생하면 훈련이나 경험만으로 그 부정적 영향을 극복할 수 없다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Checking your aircraft heading with runway alignment will help prevent

choices.text: taking off on the wrong runway.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 활주로에 진입한 뒤 aircraft heading과 runway alignment를 cross-check하면 wrong-runway takeoff를 예방하는 데 도움이 된다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Evidence proves

choices.text: more aviation accidents occur during landing and tend to be more deadly.
more aviation accidents occur during landing, but more fatal accidents occurring during takeoff.
takeoffs result in more aviation accidents, but fewer fatalities.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. 사고의 약 40.3%가 landing 중 발생하지만 사망자의 약 3.7%를 차지한다. 반면 takeoff/climb 사고는 약 16.4%이지만 사망자의 약 14.4%를 차지한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Chronic fatigue is
questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Chronic fatigue는 장기간 지속되는 피로로 지속적 높은 stress와 심리적 원인이 흔하며 질병이 원인일 수도 있다. 의사의 치료가 필요하다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Risk is increased when the pilot becomes detached from the operation and

choices.text: does not use all of the automation features to the fullest extent.
fails to monitor the systems and check the results of processes.
depends on the other pilot to use automation only partially enabled or rarely.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. 시스템 monitoring과 결과 확인을 하지 않으면 조종사는 aircraft operation에서 분리되고 complacency에 빠져 risk가 증가한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: An air carrier pilot takes off as ordered in the afternoon when embedded thunderstorms are indicated on radar and NOAA is broadcasting weather watches. This might be described as an example of
questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Resignation attitude는 'What's the use?'처럼 자신이 결과에 영향을 줄 수 없다고 생각해 포기하는 태도이며, 불합리한 요구에도 순응할 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: The FAA believes safety is
questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. FAA는 항공안전 교육과 seminar를 제공하며, flight instructor는 학생과의 모든 비행에서 기본 안전관행과 절차를 일관되게 보여주어 올바른 습관을 형성해야 한다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Situational awareness is the

choices.text: perception and classification of any three of the fundamental risk elements.
visualization and characterization of the factors and conditions affecting the flight at that particular moment.
accurate perception and understanding of all factors and conditions within the five fundamental risk elements.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Situational awareness는 비행 전·중·후 안전에 영향을 주는 기본 risk element의 모든 요인과 조건을 정확히 인지하고 이해하는 것이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Fatigue is

choices.text: a physiological state of reduced mental or physical performance capability resulting from lack of sleep or increased physical activity that can reduce a flight crew member’s alertness and ability to safely operate an aircraft or perform safety-related duties.

a physiological state of reduced mental, physical, or emotional capability that results from lack of exercise, rest, or required nutrients that can reduce a crew member’s alertness to safely perform the required duties.

a physiological state of reduced mental or physical performance capability resulting from lack of REM sleep or decreased physical activity along with illness that impairs the crew member’s alertness and ability to safely operate an aircraft or perform safety-related duties.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Fatigue는 수면부족이나 신체활동 증가 등으로 정신적·신체적 수행능력이 떨어져 승무원의 alertness와 안전운항 능력을 저하시키는 생리적 상태이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: The first step in good decision-making is

choices.text: learning how to recognize and cope with stress.
identifying personal attitudes hazardous to safe flight.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 좋은 의사결정의 첫 단계는 안전비행에 위험한 자신의 hazardous attitude를 인식·식별하는 것이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Sleep inertia refers to a period of

choices.text: heightened alertness and visual acuity following a rest period.
alignment between a person’s internal biological clock and local external time cues.
impaired performance following awakening from a regular sleep cycle or nap.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Sleep inertia는 수면·휴식 직후 일정 시간 수행능력과 vigilance가 떨어지는 상태로 졸림, lethargy, reaction time 증가와 attention lapse가 나타난다. 짧은 수면이나 큰 sleep debt 후 더 심할 수 있다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: A pilot does not perceive the difference between the assigned takeoff runway heading and the indicated heading. This is an example of
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 이륙 전 부정확한 cross-check로 wrong-runway takeoff가 발생했다면 이는 pilot/crew의 detection error이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: CRM training refers to

choices.text: the two components of flight safety and resource management, combined with mentor feedback.
the three components of initial indoctrination awareness, recurrent practice and feedback, and continual reinforcement.
the five components of initial indoctrination awareness, communication principles, recurrent practice and feedback, coordination drills, and continual reinforcement.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. CRM training의 세 핵심 구성요소는 initial indoctrination/awareness, recurrent practice and feedback, continual reinforcement이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Error management evaluation

choices.text: should recognize not all errors can be prevented.
may include error evaluation that should have been prevented.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Error management는 모든 오류를 예방할 수 없다는 사실을 인정하는 CRM의 중요한 구성요소이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: The crew monitoring function is essential,

choices.text: particularly during high altitude cruise flight modes to prevent CAT issues.
particularly during approach and landing to prevent CFIT.
during RNAV departures in class B airspace.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. 효과적인 crew monitoring은 오류를 조기에 발견해 사고로 이어지는 event chain을 끊을 수 있는 중요한 수단이다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Effective CRM reinforcement depends on
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 효과적인 CRM에는 awareness, practice/feedback, continuing reinforcement가 필요하다. LOFT, 영상 debriefing, group problem-solving, role play, attitude/personality 측정 등이 reinforcement에 활용된다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Accident prone pilots tend to
questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. 사고경향이 높은 조종사는 규칙을 경시하는 경향이 있으며, 비행사고 기록과 운전 안전위반 기록 사이에도 높은 상관이 보고되었다.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.question: Detailed investigations of runway incursions have identified
